trait.name: Existing Find Familiar Features
trait.text:
If you have a familiar from the Find Familiar spell when you cast this spell, you empower your existing familiar rather than conjuring a new one.
• For the duration, your familiar can attack in addition to taking other actions as normal, and your familiar's statistics are replaced by the Battle Familiar stat block, but it retains its Creature Type, Alignment, Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, Telepathic Connection, Pocket Dimension, and Channel Magic features granted by the Find Familiar spell.
• Your familiar gains a number of Temporary Hit points equal to the Hit Points of the battle familiar. Battle Familiar ends early if the familiar has no more Temporary Hit Points left, and these Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remains when Battle Familiar ends. Your familiar reverts to its previous form when Battle Familiar ends.

monster.name: Darkenbeast [5.5e]
monster.languages: None, understands the languages you know.

trait.name: Treasure
trait.text: None

trait.name: Magic Resistance
trait.text: The darkenbeast has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spell Imprinting
trait.text: Eaqch darkenbeast can have a single 2nd level or lower spell imprinted on it, which it can cast once per day without the need for spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. When the spell is cast this way, its effects originate from the darkenbeast (as if the darkenbeast were the caster) immediately after the spell is cast. Whether or not the spell is successful, it causes the darkenbeast to die in a puff of purple and black fire, reverting to its original mammalian form.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
trait.text: While in sunlight, the darkenbeast has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

action.text: The darkenbeast makes 1 bite attack and 2 claw attacks.

action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8+3) Piercing damage.

action.name: Shadow Stalker (Bonus Action)
action.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the darkenbeast takes the Disengage or Hide action.

monster.description:
Flying, Mutated Minion of Wickedness
Darkenbeasts are ferocious, bestial hunters created from ordinary animals by sinister spellcasters. Regardless of darkenbeasts' original forms, the magic used to create them twists them into fanged horrors with leathery wings. Most darkenbeasts have luminous bones that glow through their skin; they resemble eerie flying skeletons as they soar through the night sky. A darkenbeast is loyal to its creators, who can extract the magic used to transform it in a dramatic display that's fatal to the darkenbeast.
Darkenbeasts might have vestigial characteristics of the animals they were before transformation. Roll on or choose a result from the Darkenbeast Origin table as inspiration for these cosmetic features.
Darkenbeast Origin: 1d6 | The Darkenbeast was once a… 1 | Cobra, so it has a flared neck and scaly skin. 2 | Fox, giving it reddish fur and vulpine features. 3 | Panther, so it has sharp claws and a high-pitched scream. 4 | Rabbit, giving it long ears and a skittish demeanor. 5 | Turtle, giving it a blunt snout and shell-like carapace. 6 | Wolf, so it emits eerie howls.
An Animate Dead spell cast at 4th level is required to create a darkenbeast. This spell transforms one mammalian beast of CR 1 or lower into a darkenbeast. You can only cast this spell while you and your target creature are not in sunlight. When using a higher level spell slot, you can create one additional darkenbeast per spell slot above 4th.
Source: Arcana Unleashed
